info.title: CoreLink Customer & Privacy REST API
info.summary: REST surface for CoreLink customer onboarding, privacy (DSR / consent / DPA), billing webhooks, admin operations and health.
info.description:
Hand-authored OpenAPI 3.1 contract for the **non-REAPI** surface of CoreLink.
The high-volume CAS / AC / ByteStream / Capabilities surface is gRPC
(Remote Execution API v2) and documented separately under
`docs/reference/reapi/`.

Endpoint canonical paths are sourced from the implementing crates' doc-comments:
`corelink-signup`, `corelink-dpa-acceptance`, `corelink-dpa-versioning`,
`corelink-tier-selection`, `corelink-pat`, `corelink-dsr`,
`corelink-privacy-consent-ledger`, `corelink-admin-api`,
`corelink-enterprise-inquiry`, plus `apps/server::webhook` (Stripe).

**Stability:** `v1` — public, semver-compatible. Breaking changes require a
new major path prefix (`/v2/...`).

/v1/signup.x-reconciliation-note:
Distinct intent from the SERVER-ONLY `/v1/signup/pilot/{token}`
(pilot-program HMAC-token redemption, axum-mounted in
`crates/corelink-container/src/routes/signup.rs`). The customer-
facing self-service signup endpoint is the one documented here;
`crates/corelink-signup` ships the orchestrator + atomic-
provisioning logic, awaiting the CF Worker entry crate to bind it.

post.summary: Provision a new tenant from a verified Clerk identity.
post.description:
Idempotent signup orchestration. The orchestrator wraps tenant row +
DPA acceptance row + first PAT issuance in a single atomic D1
transaction (`INV-ONBOARD-ATOMIC-PROVISIONING`). Stripe customer
creation is a best-effort saga step — Stripe outage degrades to
`Deferred` with `billing_intent="deferred"`; the tenant is still
provisioned and signed up.

Request body intentionally has **no PAT field** (`CTRL-CRED-001`);
the first PAT is returned in the response (shown-once token).

202.description: Tenant provisioned, billing deferred (Stripe outage / chaos).

503.description: Transient backend outage (Stripe or D1); safe to retry with same `Idempotency-Key`.

post.summary: Record click-through acceptance of the current DPA version.
post.x-reconciliation-note:
Business-logic crate `corelink-dpa-acceptance` ships the service +
schema (doc-comments mark `POST /v1/dpa/accept` as canonical). Axum
binding is deferred to PRR per `trait-abstraction-defer` charter
(tools/openapi/src/lib.rs L29-39 — utoipa derives land with the
CF Worker entry crate). Reconciled 2026-05-27 per
specs/_audits/2026-05-27-openapi-reconciliation-seal.md.
post.description:
Records 6-field consent proof (`notice_text_hash`, `notice_version`,
`locale`, `wording_id`, `ui_capture_ts`, `submission_ts` server-set)
and emits an RS256-signed JWT receipt. Idempotent on
`(tenant_id, notice_text_hash, ui_capture_ts)`.

201.description: Acceptance recorded; JWT receipt returned and emailed.

409.description: Idempotent replay — original receipt returned unchanged.

post.summary: Re-accept a major-bumped DPA notice within the 30-day grace window.
post.x-reconciliation-note:
`RE_ACCEPT_PATH` const in
`crates/corelink-privacy/src/dpa/versioning/middleware.rs:67` is the
canonical gate token used by the read-only-degrade middleware. The
middleware identifies this path but the actual handler axum mount
is deferred to the CF Worker entry crate.
post.description:
When a new DPA version is published the tenant enters a 30-day grace
window; `corelink-dpa-versioning` middleware flips writes to read-only
until the customer self-recovers via this endpoint.

201.description: Re-acceptance recorded; tenant returns to read-write.

403.description: Grace window expired; tenant is now read-only-frozen and requires manual unfreeze via admin.

post.summary: Select a subscription tier and receive a Stripe Checkout session URL.
post.x-reconciliation-note:
`crates/corelink-tier-selection/src/lib.rs` doc-comments mark
`POST /v1/onboarding/tier-select` as canonical (Lote 10.16 fix).
Sprint S-19 WI-S19-004 (sealed) scopes the handler; the axum
mount lives in the deferred CF Worker entry crate.
post.description:
Enforces `INV-ONBOARD-DPA-FIRST` via a D1 lock — tier selection is
rejected until a DPA acceptance row exists for the tenant.
Returns a Stripe Checkout session URL; final activation happens
when the corresponding `checkout.session.completed` event lands
on `/v1/billing/stripe-webhook`.

403.description: DPA-first lock — caller must accept current DPA before selecting a tier.

/v1/pats.x-reconciliation-note:
PAT primitives (`mint`, `verify`, `format`, `argon`, `scopes`) all
ship in `crates/corelink-pat`. SDK quickstarts (`quickstart_put.py`,
`quickstart_list.py`) target this path; the binding is on the
CF Worker entry-crate deferral list.

post.summary: Issue a new Personal Access Token.
post.description:
Returns the raw token material **once** (`shown_once`). The token is
hashed (BLAKE3-keyed) before storage; subsequent reads only ever
return the hash prefix and metadata.

get.summary: List the caller's Personal Access Tokens.

200.description: PAT list (metadata only — no raw token material).

delete.summary: Revoke a Personal Access Token by id.

204.description: Revoked. Subsequent uses MUST fail closed (`INV-PAT-REVOKE-PROPAGATION`).

post.summary: Receive a Stripe webhook event (HMAC-SHA256 signature required).
post.description:
Implemented at `apps/server::webhook::stripe_webhook_handler`.
Validates the `Stripe-Signature` header (5-minute replay window),
deduplicates on `event.id`, then dispatches to the subscription
handler. Unknown / out-of-scope event types are acknowledged with
200 OK (fire-and-forget contract).

**NOT secured by BearerPAT / Clerk** — see `StripeSignature` scheme.

200.description: Event accepted (including idempotent replays and acknowledged unknown event types).

400.description: Missing or invalid signature, or malformed event body.

500.description: Transient backend error; Stripe will retry.

/v1/privacy/dsr/{action}.x-reconciliation-note:
`crates/corelink-dsr/src/endpoint.rs` marks
`POST /v1/privacy/dsr/{access|portability|...}` as canonical;
Sprint S-11 WI-S11-001 (sealed) scopes the 7-endpoint surface.
Axum mount deferred to CF Worker entry crate.

post.summary: Submit a Data Subject Request (GDPR / LGPD / CCPA).
post.description:
6 supported actions per `corelink-dsr::event::DsrRequestKind`:
`access`, `portability`, `rectification`, `erasure`, `restriction`,
`objection`. Destructive arms (`erasure`, `rectification`) require
a fresh MFA step-up token via `X-MFA-Step-Up-Token`.

Returns an RS256-signed JWT receipt (90-day validity) on
acceptance. SLA deadline is jurisdiction-bound (GDPR 30d / LGPD
15d / CCPA 45d).

403.description: MFA step-up required (destructive arm) or token expired.

get.summary: Poll the status of a previously submitted DSR.

/v1/consent/{purpose}.x-reconciliation-note:
Consent data layer present in `corelink-privacy::consent::ledger`
(doc-comments mark `POST /v1/consent/<purpose>` + `DELETE` symmetric
revoke as canonical). No axum mount yet; deferred to CF Worker.

post.summary: Grant consent for one canonical purpose.
post.description:
12 canonical purposes per `privacy_model.md §5.6.1`. Records 6-field
proof (`notice_text_hash`, `notice_version`, `locale`, `wording_id`,
`ui_capture_ts`, `submission_ts`) and HMAC-SHA256 signs with
tenant-scoped key (HKDF `corelink/v1/consent-hmac`).

delete.summary: Revoke consent for one canonical purpose (symmetric proof).
delete.description:
Per Lote 9.4 H-05 the revocation row carries the **same 6-field
proof shape** as the grant. Cascade to downstream processing
within 24h (`CTRL-PRIV-CONSENT-002`).

get.summary: List all grants + revocations for the calling subject.
Public stateless verify of a grant signature.
Public stateless verify of a revocation signature.

/v1/admin/ops.x-reconciliation-note:
`crates/corelink-ops/src/admin/api.rs` carries the `corelink-admin-api`
pipeline + dual-approval gate. Distinct intent from the SERVER-ONLY
`/v1/admin/read/:resource` + `/v1/admin/mutate` placeholder routes,
which expose an in-memory admin handler used for the wave-11 wire-up
demonstration. The dual-approval-gated `/v1/admin/ops*` family is the
production surface; CF Worker entry crate binds it.

post.description:
Implemented by `corelink-admin-api::middleware::AdminApiPipeline`.
Enforces `INV-ADMIN-DUAL-APPROVAL` (caller + distinct approver
with fresh MFA) and audit-emit-BEFORE-handler atomically.
Op taxonomy: `ConfigRollback`, `SecretRotationStart`,
`TenantTombstone`, plus runbook-specific variants.

409.description: Approver collision (caller == approver) or duplicate nonce.

get.summary: Inspect an admin op (status + audit envelope).

post.summary: Approve a pending admin op (second-approver step).

409.description: Approver collision or op already approved/rejected.

/v1/admin/audit/events.x-reconciliation-note:
Distinct intent from the SERVER-ONLY `/v1/audit/export` (bulk R2
export) and `/v1/audit/analytics/*` (event-count + timeline
aggregates). This is the per-tenant admin event-search surface
paginated for the admin UI. SDK quickstarts currently target a
dashed `/v1/admin/audit-events` typo (`tools/sdks/{go,python}/
examples/quickstart_audit.{go,py}`) — SDK fix tracked separately;
the dashed variant is NOT canonical. CLI quickstart at
`tools/cli/examples/quickstart_audit.rs:31` shares the typo.

post.summary: Submit an enterprise sales / BYOK inquiry.
post.description:
Implemented by `corelink-enterprise-inquiry`. Atomic outbox to
Slack channel + CRM lead; 24h auto-reply SLA.

/api/health.x-reconciliation-note:
Adapter-host pip server exposes `/healthz` (rows 28 of route inventory
§2) for its own liveness, but that is the pip-adapter port, not the
customer API surface. The canonical `/api/health` endpoint lives in
the CF Worker entry crate; native server container has no liveness
route mounted at this path.

/api/csp-report.x-reconciliation-note:
S-16 WI-S16-001 (sealed) scopes the CSP-report intake on the
Next.js side; the corresponding backend ingestion endpoint here is
pending the CF Worker entry crate.

post.summary: Redeem an HMAC-signed pilot signup token.
post.description:
Server-only route (axum-mounted). Token format
`pilot_<env>_<unix_ms>_<16-hex-random>.<hmac-hex>` verified in
constant time via `subtle::ConstantTimeEq`. TTL 14 days from mint.
Rate-limited 5/IP/hour. Audit-emit fail-CLOSED per
`INV-AUDIT-EMIT-ATOMIC-WITH-HANDLER`.

201.description: Pilot tenant reserved; activation URL returned.

503.description: Audit pipeline or signup store unavailable (fail-CLOSED).

get.summary: Admin-plane read of a typed resource.
get.description:
End-to-end wire-up of `corelink_handler_admin::AdminReadHandler`
against an `Arc<dyn ...>` trait-object route state. Emits
`Sli::AvailControlPlane` per route entry.

post.description:
`AdminMutateHandler` enforces (1) RBAC (initiator must hold admin
role), (2) dual-approval token presence, (3) approver ≠ initiator.
Each path emits the corresponding `MutateAttempted` /
`MutateDenied` / `MutateDualApprovalRejected` audit row BEFORE
the response (audit-emit-BEFORE-handler atomicity).

get.summary: List pilot tenants filtered by lifecycle state.
get.description:
Replaces the wave-27 `list-pilot-tenants.sh` shell script.
Auth: Clerk JWT with scope `corelink:admin:pilots`; the route
re-checks the scope at the boundary (5-Layer Defense).

post.description:
Replaces the wave-27 `grant-pilot-tier.sh` shell script.
Transitions `pilot_state` NEW → ACTIVE atomically with
`tier_granted_at_ms` set.

Replaces the wave-27 `pilot-24h-checkin.sh` shell script.
Emits an alert audit row when the tenant has not uploaded a single
blob 24h after `tier_granted_at_ms`.

get.summary: Stream a bulk audit-chain export from R2.
get.description:
Streams the per-tenant audit chain over the supplied `[from, to)`
window. Window bounds accept either ISO 8601 UTC
(`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`) or raw Unix epoch milliseconds. Cross-
tenant attempts emit a security audit row BEFORE the 403.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound (ISO 8601 UTC or Unix ms).

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description:
Optional — when supplied as a different tenant than the
authenticated principal, the route emits a cross-tenant
attempt audit row and returns 403.

X-Chain-Head-Anchor.description: Hex BLAKE3 hash anchor for client verification.

get.summary: Event-type count aggregates over a time window.

200.description: Aggregated counts grouped by event type.

get.summary: Event-count timeline bucketed at a chosen granularity.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description:
Bucket size in milliseconds (capped at 24h). Default chosen by
the handler to keep `(to - from) / granularity ≤ 1000`.

/v1/cas/{tenant}/{hash}.x-binding-note:
REAPI HTTP fake — production CAS reads land on the gRPC ByteStream
surface (docs/reference/reapi/). This HTTP route exists for the
native-build dev / integration-test loop and the wave-11 end-to-end
wire-up demonstration. Cross-tenant denials enforced at the
route boundary in addition to the handler layer.

get.summary: Read a CAS blob by `(tenant, content-hash)`.

/v1/cas/{digest}.x-binding-note:
REAPI read-only binary (`corelink-reapi::http_read`) — distinct
listener from the container surface. Exposes the same intent as
`/v1/cas/{tenant}/{hash}` but addresses blobs by canonical digest
and resolves the tenant via auth context rather than path.

get.summary: Read a CAS blob by canonical digest (REAPI binary).

/v1/ac/{tenant}/{action_digest}.x-binding-note:
REAPI HTTP fake for the Action Cache — production AC traffic uses
the gRPC ActionCache service. Cross-tenant denials emit
`AuditEventKind::LookupDenied` / `UpdateDenied` BEFORE the 403.

get.summary: Look up an Action Cache result.

schema.description: Hex digest of the action's `ActionResult` key.

BearerPAT.description:
`Authorization: Bearer <PAT>` where PAT is a 32-byte UUIDv7-derived
opaque token (BLAKE3-keyed hash in DB). Tier 1 of the canonical
auth ladder per `corelink-pat`. Scopes encoded in PAT row.

ClerkSessionCookie.name: __session
ClerkSessionCookie.description: Clerk browser session cookie (alternative to PAT for the web onboarding flow).

StripeSignature.name: Stripe-Signature
StripeSignature.description: HMAC-SHA256 webhook signature; verified by `apps/server::webhook::stripe_webhook_handler` against the secret in `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` env var with a 5-minute replay window.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated idempotency token. Same key replays the original response (no duplicate provisioning).

AdminOperationReason.name: X-Admin-Operation-Reason
AdminOperationReason.description: Free-text justification recorded in the audit envelope for every admin mutation. Required for all `/v1/admin/*` write endpoints.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this resource.

InternalError.description: Server error. Safe to retry idempotent operations.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code from the canonical error taxonomy (`error_taxonomy.md`).

message.description: Human-readable explanation (locale-neutral; do NOT echo back PII).

request_id.description: Server-assigned request id for support correlation.

clerk_event_id.description: Clerk webhook event id (idempotency anchor at the identity provider).

email_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of normalized email. **Raw email is NEVER transmitted to the server** (CTRL-PRIV-001).

notice_text_hash.description: SHA-256 of the notice text the user saw.

shown_once_token.description: Raw PAT material — **shown exactly once**. Stored BLAKE3-keyed; never retrievable again.

prefix.description: First 8 chars of the raw token (display only).

StripeWebhookEnvelope.description: The Stripe-shaped event envelope; only fields the handler reads are typed here.

request_payload_hash.description: SHA-256 of the rectification / portability payload (when applicable). Used as part of the idempotency 4-tuple.

approver_signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 over `(payload || nonce || ts_ms)` with the admin signing key.

primary_contact_email_hash.description: SHA-256 hex; raw email NOT exposed.

CspReport.description: Schema accepts the legacy `csp-report` envelope and the new Reporting API `csp-violation` payload.

Bcp47Locale.description: BCP-47 locale (Lote 10.16 canonical 3-locale set currently — en-US, pt-BR, fr-FR).

PrimaryRegion.description: 3-region canonical map per `corelink-region` / Lote 10.16 locale→region binding.

PilotSignupRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /v1/signup/pilot/{token}`. All four fields
are required; each is capped at 256 chars
(`MAX_FIELD_LEN` in `crates/corelink-container/src/routes/signup.rs`).

tenant_id.description: UUIDv7 assigned to the reserved pilot tenant.

approval_id.description:
Dual-approval ledger id (omit = rejected — handler emits
`MutateDualApprovalRejected` BEFORE the 403).

approver.description: Second approver principal (must differ from initiator).
